arguments.sql: SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, orders.status, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.id = 130 GROUP BY orders.id;

arguments.subject: Order No. 130 Details
